Group.label: Spelling and Orthography
Group.description: Flags misspellings and words that should be elided, like `le arbre` for `l'arbre`.

Group.label: Grammar and Agreement
Group.description: Catches articles that don't agree with their noun's gender.

Group.label: Numbers and Units
Group.description: Checks how numbers are written, such as ordinal suffixes like `1er` and `2e`.
